usage_title: MyFox is a toolkit for installing and maintaining the official Firefox with MyFox tweaks: update, reinstall, start and restart, uninstall.
cmd_browser: Launch the installed browser (extra arguments go to Firefox)
cmd_restart: Restart the browser with its windows and tabs (not running: just start it)
cmd_refresh: Update the tweaks, the themes, the bookmarklet styling and MyFox (--force: forced update)
cmd_reinstall: Reinstall Firefox and apply the tweaks
err_installdir_empty: The install directory can't be empty.
err_installdir_foreign: '{0}' already has files in it that aren't MyFox's.
err_installdir_cannot_create: '{0}' isn't writable, so the install directory can't be created there.
progress_network_silent: {0} no answer from the network: {1} of {2} s
err_network_silent: No answer from the network for {0} s; the download is stopped.
install_cancelled: The install is cancelled; what it had created is removed.
install_done_run: Launch: «Firefox» in the applications menu («Firefox with the MyFox tweaks»), or myfox browser
err_import_in_use: First close the Firefox that has the profile «{0}» open.
warn_import_downgrade: The profile was last opened by Firefox {0}, newer than {1} being installed, and may not work right. Press Install again to go on at your own risk.
warn_import_downgrade_cli: The profile was last opened by Firefox {0}, newer than {1} being installed, and may not work right. To go on at your own risk: --allow-downgrade
refresh_restart_firefox: Restart Firefox to apply the update
note_plasma_pkg_missing: KDE Plasma integration needs the system package «plasma-browser-integration». Install it: {0}
note_plasma_pkg_missing_manual: KDE Plasma integration needs the system package «plasma-browser-integration»; install it with your package manager.
note_plasma_addon_failed: Could not download the Plasma Integration add-on from addons.mozilla.org.
note_gui_failed: Could not install the graphical interface ({0}): MyFox windows won't open, the terminal commands work.
note_pin_failed: Could not tie the MyFox profile to this Firefox: Firefox didn't start (missing system libraries?). Firefox may open another profile; run `myfox reinstall` once it starts.
reinstall_keeps_profile: The profile (bookmarks, history, settings) stays as it is.
needs_yes_uninstall_profile: To delete the profile as well: {0}
uninstall_subtitle: Firefox and MyFox will be removed
uninstall_remove_profile: Also delete the profile (bookmarks, history, passwords)

err_no_space: Not enough space in {0}: the profile needs {1} MB.
